what_this_is: GB transmission connection points (132 kV and above) that data-grid-gb could locate, extracted for distance rollups only. A point is a joined map location, not a surveyed site boundary.

attribution.identities: NESO, Electricity Ten Year Statement 2025, Appendix B (site names, owners, voltages), as derived by Ventusltd/data-grid-gb.
attribution.coordinates: Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database Licence (ODbL 1.0), joined to ETYS identities by Ventusltd/data-grid-gb via the GridAtlas release.
attribution.licence_note: The coordinates are OSM-derived: the ODbL attribution and share-alike terms apply to this extract and to rollups that publish them. data-grid-gb carries no LICENSE file at the pinned commit; the owner should confirm terms for the NESO-derived fields before wider redistribution.
